en: Sepia-toned street view showing a historic European town. On the right is a prominent oriel bay window with ornate brackets and flower boxes on the corner of a building. The cobblestone street curves into the distance, lined with multi-story townhouses and shops with awnings; a few pedestrians and a cart are visible. German text is printed at the top identifying the location as Pirna on the Elbe River and specifying the corner of Langestraße and Badergasse.
